title: The Apps page's title. Apps are small web apps socios (the product's AI agents) build for people.
refresh: Button that reloads the list of apps.
description: The page's intro. A socio's computer is the sandbox it works in; the data space is where the person's datasets are.
load-failed: Error toast when the apps could not load.
share-failed: Error toast when changing whom an app is shared with failed.
action-failed: Error toast when rolling back, unpublishing or publishing an app failed, without a reason from the server.
open-failed: Error toast when an app could not open.
unregistered: Toast after unregistering an app. {{name}} is its name.
not-set-up.title: Shown when this server doesn't serve mini apps.
not-set-up.description: Text under it. APPS_HOST and docs/SETUP.md are a setting's and a file's names; keep them.
empty.title: Shown when the person has no apps.
kind.ephemeral: Badge: the app runs only while its socio's computer runs.
kind.packaged: Badge: the socio packaged the app; it can be promoted.
kind.promoted: Badge: the app was promoted and runs in the workspace on its own.
kind.unpublished: Badge: a promoted app its owner took offline.
state.running: Badge: the app runs and answers.
state.failed: Badge: the app failed to run.
state.not-running: Badge: the app doesn't run now.
state.not-answering: Badge: the socio's computer runs, but the app doesn't answer.
state.computer-stopped: Badge: the socio's computer is stopped, so the app isn't reachable.
state.unavailable: Badge: the app's state isn't known.
health.last-recovered: Sentence: when the app last repaired itself ({{when}}, a date and time) and how ({{reason}}, from the server in English, or the word repaired).
health.repaired: The repair's description when the server gave none.
health.recovering: Sentence: the app is repairing itself.
health.degraded: Sentence: a repair failed; it tries again by itself.
health.degraded-next: The same, with when it next tries ({{when}}, a date and time).
health.gave-up: Sentence: automatic repair stopped after {{count}} attempts. Start is a button's name.
health.attempt: Sentence: which repair attempt this is ({{attempt}}) out of how many ({{count}}).
health.last-error: Sentence: the last repair's error. {{error}} is from the server, in English.
card.shared-by: In an app's details line: the person who shared it with you. {{name}} is their name.
card.version: In an app's details line: its live version number.
card.port: In an app's details line: the network port it listens on in the socio's computer.
card.report: Tooltip of the button that files an issue about the app.
card.report-label: Accessible name of that button. {{name}} is the app's name.
card.open: Button that opens the app in a new tab.
card.needs-setup: Shown when secrets the app needs aren't set. {{names}} lists the secrets' technical names; {{count}} how many. Settings → Secrets is the page's name.
card.build-failed: An app's last build failed. {{version}} is the version number.
card.data: The datasets the app may use. {{datasets}} lists their names.
card.shared-with: Label of the list of whom the app is shared with: only its owner, or a Space (a product noun).
card.promote: Button that opens the wizard that promotes the app into the workspace.
card.rollback: Button that goes back to the previous version. {{version}} is that version's number.
card.rolled-back: Toast after rolling back. {{name}} is the app's name, {{version}} the version it runs now.
card.unpublish: Button that takes a promoted app offline, keeping its data.
card.unpublished: Toast after unpublishing. {{name}} is the app's name.
card.publish: Button that puts an unpublished app back online.
card.published: Toast after publishing. {{name}} is the app's name.
card.logs: Button that opens the app's build and start logs.
card.delete: Button that opens the dialog that deletes a promoted app.
card.unregister: Button that unregisters an ephemeral or packaged app.
versions.count: Summary of the collapsed list of the app's packaged versions.
versions.line: One packaged version: {{version}} its number, {{count}} how many files, {{when}} when it was packaged. The live form marks the one that runs, the previous form the one before.
others.title: Heading, for admins, of the apps in the workspace they can't open.
others.description: Text under it. Space is a product noun.
others.by: After an app's name: its owner. {{name}} is their name.
